capabilities: Show a 12-hour or 24-hour clock in the status bar
Toggle ticking seconds on the clock
Start, pause and reset a session stopwatch
Switch the stopwatch between HH:MM:SS and uncapped MM:SS
Tint the status bar with the theme accent color
disambiguation: Not a drawing or annotation tool; "painted" refers to tinting the whole status bar with the active theme's accent color.
extras: Desktop only. Install via BRAT or by copying manifest.json, main.js and styles.css from the GitHub releases page into the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian's status bar has no clock or session timer, and coloring it with the theme accent otherwise requires a separate CSS snippet.
summary: Status bar clock with 12/24-hour formats and optional seconds, plus a session stopwatch and optional accent-color status bar tinting.
